task_description: Fix the broken preset switching system in Elementor widgets (wrong presets loading, bound flag preventing re-binding, incorrect API usage) and redesign the homepage to be more modern, advanced, and distinctive with unique visual elements and a new portfolio section.

verification.summary: FEAT-001: preset-handler.js completely rewritten - uses $e.run for atomic settings, removed viraPresetBound flag, panel re-renders after preset change, event listener uses clone-replace pattern. All 12 widget control IDs verified to match preset data keys. FEAT-002: Homepage redesigned from 9 to 10 sections with animated gradient mesh hero, new portfolio/case-studies section, enhanced stats with SVG progress rings, and improved services bento grid with unique per-service illustrations.
